t: The Hive V4 wireless heating and hot water smart thermostat combines elegant touch-button design with intuitive control for complete home comfort management. This battery-powered device lets you manage both heating and hot water remotely via mobile or tablet, activating systems only when needed to reduce energy waste. The touchscreen thermostat integrates seamlessly with Amazon Alexa, Apple HomeKit and Google Home, plus iOS and Android apps for convenient control from anywhere. Features include heating and hot water boost for up to 6 hours, automatic frost protection for pipes, and a 7-day programmable schedule, with a supplied smart hub managing your home's comfort intelligently.
b: Works with - Amazon Alexa - Apple HomeKit - Google Home - iOS App - Android App
Suitable for System & Heat Only Boilers
